title: Birthday Bonus: issuance flow

check: Screen pass? | yes: next | no: stop Skip player

step: Record, Claimed = Yes

Reward eligible Tier 3 and Tier V players on their birthday with a controlled credit, once per year, sized to the player's own value and never stacked with another reward.
Applies to all VIP CS on every brand. High-value cases (Total Deposit at or above RM 100,000) must be handled by the ATL or above. One claim per player per calendar year.
